title_sq: Shitet apartament tek hotel Colosseo ID: 530191074-120
description_sq:
Shitet nje apartament me siperfaqe totale 78 m2,i ndare ne 2 apartamente 1+1 dhe Garsoniere.
Apartamentet ndodhen ne katin 4 te nje objekti ekzistues.
Te dyja apartamentet jane te rinovuara plotesisht me punime cilesore,dhe jepen momentalisht me qira ditore.

Prona disponon certifikate pronesie dhe shitet me cmimin 185.000 Euro.
title_en: Apartment for sale at Colosseo hotel ID: 530191074-120
description_en: An apartment for sale with a total area of ​​78 m2, divided into 2 apartments 1+1 and a studio. The apartments are located on the 4th floor of an existing building. The facility where the property is located is on the edge of the Durres road, and has very good access to the central roads of Tirana. The property has ownership certificates and is sold at the price of 185,000 Euros.
